name: Tandem Evasion [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You and your allies help each other evade deadly attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Dodge.

Benefit(s): You grant adjacent allies evasion against a dragon’s breath weapon and tail sweep special attacks. If they already have evasion, they gain improved evasion instead.
